newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Payless ShoeSource estimate raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Payless ShoeSource estimate raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Inc said Tuesday it raised its estimate for Payless ShoeSource Inc's fiscal 1997 earnings to $3.07 from $3.03 a share and introduced an estimate for fiscal 1998 of $3.52.
-- Gruntal said the move reflects slightly higher gross margin assumptions for the core Payless business, which announced new growth targets of 15 percent average annual earnings per share increases.
-- Payless reported fourth-quarter earnings of $0.38 a share, versus a loss of $0.80 a year ago. The latest figure was above Gruntal's estimate of $0.35, Gruntal said.
-- Its shares closed up one Tuesday at 43.
